answer: Each epoch the network calls a surprise live roll-call: every identity must answer a fresh interactive challenge inside ninety seconds. A lone operator cannot steer a hundred puppets through a hundred simultaneous roll-calls, so a Sybil nebula collapses the moment its puppets miss the same call, while an honest agent answers once and keeps its jetty to the network. A missed call burns trust like an ember starved of air, and three misses in a row suspend the identity until it re-earns standing. The honest pay one minute per epoch; the farmer must staff a hundred live operators.
